cases.name: identity-ascii
cases.covers: The common page: no map, and the two spaces are the same size.

cases.name: identity-empty
cases.covers: A page with no text at all.

cases.name: identity-bmp-non-ascii
cases.covers: Accented and CJK text is still one unit per character, so still identity.

cases.name: identity-combining
cases.covers: A combining mark is its own character and its own unit, so it does not make a map.

cases.name: identity-rtl
cases.covers: Right-to-left text is a display concern, not an index one.

cases.name: one-dropped-character-at-the-start
cases.covers: The first character is non-printing, so text starts at character one.

cases.name: one-dropped-character-in-the-middle
cases.covers: A plateau in the middle, which is what the bias rules exist for.

cases.name: one-dropped-character-at-the-end
cases.covers: A trailing non-printing character, so the tail rule is exercised.

cases.name: several-consecutive-dropped-characters
cases.covers: A wide plateau, where a boundary search can land in the middle.

cases.name: every-character-dropped
cases.covers: A page of nothing but non-printing characters.

cases.name: one-supplementary-character
cases.covers: A surrogate pair is one character and two units.

cases.name: supplementary-at-the-start
cases.covers: The pair is the first character, so the map starts at anchor one.

cases.name: supplementary-at-the-end
cases.covers: The pair is last, so the tail rule sees the expansion.

cases.name: consecutive-supplementary-characters
cases.covers: Two pairs in a row, so the anchors compound.

cases.name: dropped-and-supplementary-together
cases.covers: The two deviations interleaved, which is what a real page looks like.

cases.name: astral-text-with-no-ascii
cases.covers: Nothing in the string is one byte or one unit, which is where UTF-8 maths slips.

violations.name: valid-identity
violations.covers: The control: a sound absent map.

violations.name: identity-with-mismatched-sizes
violations.covers: No map, but the spaces differ, so one of the two numbers is wrong.
violations.violation: identity map requires charCount (5) === text length (4)

violations.name: anchor-not-increasing
violations.covers: Two anchors at the same character.

violations.name: anchor-going-backwards
violations.covers: An anchor before the previous one.

violations.name: anchor-at-zero
violations.covers: The head anchor is implicit, so an explicit [0, 0] is malformed.

violations.name: step-of-one
violations.covers: A step of one is what an anchor means NOT to encode, so it is a violation.
violations.violation: anchor 0 implies a character contributing 1 text units (expected 0 or 2)

violations.name: step-of-one-that-the-tail-rule-would-accept
violations.covers: Only the step rule catches this: the anchors increase, sit in range, and project onto the right length. A step of one is what an anchor means NOT to encode.
violations.violation: anchor 0 implies a character contributing 1 text units (expected 0 or 2)

violations.name: step-of-three
violations.violation: anchor 0 implies a character contributing 3 text units (expected 0 or 2)

violations.name: negative-step
violations.covers: A map that runs the text backwards.

violations.name: tail-too-short
violations.covers: A sound map that projects onto the wrong length.
violations.violation: map projects charCount to 6, but text length is 9

violations.name: valid-dropped
violations.covers: A sound map with one dropped character.

violations.name: valid-supplementary
violations.covers: A sound map with one surrogate pair.
